# Kesari — The Memory Studio
> Bangalore's premier acoustic chamber, live music venue, pro audio rental provider, and 100% pure vegetarian cafe in Koramangala.

## Core Information
- **Location**: Koramangala 4th Block, Bangalore, Karnataka 560034, India
- **Coordinates**: 12.9352° N, 77.6245° E
- **Operating Hours**: 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM IST daily
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 77605 39955
- **Official Website**: https://kesaristudio.com
- **Venue Policy**: Strictly 100% Pure Vegetarian and Alcohol-Free

## Spaces & Capacity
- **Concert Hall & Stage**: Capacity up to 200 guests. Equipped with Line Array PA rig, DMX stage lighting, artist green room, and live sound engineer. From ₹15,000.
- **Acoustic Lounge & Jam Room**: Capacity up to 60 guests. Soundproofed timber acoustic chamber, Shure vocal microphones, velvet club seating, direct artisanal cafe access. From ₹6,000.
- **Creator Workshop Room**: Capacity up to 40 guests. 4K laser projector, gigabit Wi-Fi, modular layout. From ₹5,000.

## Audio Rental Gear
- Active PA Speakers: Yamaha DBR12 (1000W 2-way), Yamaha DBR15, QSC K12.2
- Subwoofers: Yamaha DXS15mkII (1020W active sub), JBL PRX818XLFW
- Consoles: Soundcraft Signature 16 (Lexicon FX), Yamaha MG12XU, Behringer X32 Producer
- Microphones: Shure SM58 dynamic, Shure Beta 58A, Sennheiser EW 100 G4 wireless systems
- DJ Equipment: Pioneer DDJ-FLX6-GT, Pioneer XDJ-RX3
- Sound Engineers: Certified live audio engineers available for setup and FOH mixing.

## Pure Vegetarian Cafe & Catering
- In-house 100% Pure Vegetarian kitchen.
- Stone-baked sourdough pizzas, slow-simmered dal makhani, wild mushroom risottos, artisanal cold brews, and mocktails.
- Bulk catering available for private events with 48 hours advance notice (Jain and Satvik preparations available).
